title: Experiment 4 (Exploratory, non-confirmatory): Swift Grammar Support via Tree-sitter (aptu-coder#648)
control_condition: x1 user prompt block (runner-prompt-v3, one copy)
treatment_condition: x2 user prompt block duplicated verbatim (runner-prompt-v3 appended twice); system instructions unchanged
rubric_version: rubric.md (C1, C2, C6) + rubric-v3.md (C3, C4, C5, C7)
data_note: Exploratory and non-confirmatory: Experiment 4 is not part of the paper's confirmatory series (Exp1-Exp3) and is not in Table 7 or the paper. Only the main run (scout-run-07..16, n=5+5) is analysed here; pilot rounds 01-06 (runner prompts v1/v2 and rubric v1/v2, three rounds of n=1+1 with scores 0/7, 3/7, 5/7) are tracked in this directory but excluded. Treatment definition differs from Exp1-Exp3: the entire user prompt block is duplicated verbatim and the system instructions are unchanged, whereas Exp1-Exp3 repeat the Scout instructions. Delegate model inception/mercury-2.5-preview via OpenRouter, temperature 0.5. messages is taken from the session file's message_count field, the only available source; those values are 0/1 and are not turn counts, so they are not comparable to Exp1-Exp3 and are excluded from the published message totals. Judge 1 is a single blind Claude Haiku 4.5 pass over scores-main-run.json; the rubric was authored across three revision rounds for this experiment and was not independently inter-rater-checked before the run (second-judge rescore: irr/exp4-scores.json). Two slots (scout-run-13, scout-run-15) needed retries after a repeat-tool-call failure; only the first successful completion per slot is scored, and the per-run tokens, wall clock and bytes are those of that successful attempt. recipes/*.yaml keep run-specific absolute output paths and worktree paths from the machine that ran the experiment.

statistical_test.note: n=5 per group; two-sided exact permutation over all 252 group assignments (computed in pure Python; scipy not available); descriptive only, no confirmatory test was pre-registered for this experiment

conclusion: Exploratory and non-confirmatory; not in Table 7 or the paper. Control mean 4.2/7 vs treatment mean 4.0/7 (Mann-Whitney U=15.0, exact two-sided p=1.0, rank-biserial r=-0.20). The two groups are indistinguishable on this rubric at n=5+5: C1 and C2 are 0/10 in both groups (floor), C3, C5, C6 and C7 are 10/10 in both groups (ceiling), and the only criterion with variance (C4, 1/10) differs by a single run. The instrument has too little headroom to show an effect either way.
pre_acknowledged_limitations: exploratory and non-confirmatory: not part of the paper's confirmatory series, no pre-registered hypothesis test, results reported descriptively only
